verse.verse_1: Say thou; I seek refuge with the Lord of the daybreak.
verse.verse_2: From the evil of that which He hath created,
verse.verse_3: And from the evil of the darken when it cometh,
verse.verse_4: And from the evil of the women blowers upon knots,
verse.verse_5: And from the evil of the envier when he envieth.
